extinct.definition:
a. no longer in existence; lost or especially having died out leaving no living representatives
a. (of e.g. volcanos) permanently inactive
s. being out or having grown cold
extinct.translation:
a. 熄灭的, 灭绝的, 耗尽的
[法] 消灭了的, 过时的, 无效的

extinction.definition:
n. no longer active; extinguished
n. no longer in existence
n. the reduction of the intensity of radiation as a consequence of absorption and radiation
extinction.translation:
n. 消失, 消灭, 废止
[化] 消光; 熄灭

extinction of crime.translation: [法] 消灭犯罪, 犯罪的消灭

extinction of debt.translation: [经] 债务消除, 还清债务

extinction tests.translation: [医] [皮疹]消失现象, 舒-查二氏现象

extinctions.definition:
plural of extinction
n. no longer active; extinguished
n. no longer in existence
n. the reduction of the intensity of radiation as a consequence of absorption and radiation
extinctions.translation:
(extinction 的复数) n. 消失, 消灭, 废止
[化] 消光; 熄灭

extinctive.translation:
a. 使消灭的
[医] 消退的

extine.definition:
n. The outer membrane of the grains of pollen of flowering
   plants.
extine.translation: n. [植]花粉粒外壁, 孢子外壁

extinguish.definition: v. terminate, end, or take out
extinguish.translation:
vt. 熄灭, 使消亡, 压制, 使减色
[医] 消灭

extinguish(ing) material.translation: [化] 灭火料; 灭火材料

extinguishable.definition:
a. Capable of being quenched, destroyed, or
   suppressed.
extinguishable.translation: a. 可熄灭的, 可绝灭的

extinguished.definition: s. of a conditioned response; caused to die out because of the absence or withdrawal of reinforcement
extinguished.translation: v. 使熄灭, 扑灭( extinguish的过去式和过去分词 ); 使…不复存在

extinguisher.definition: n a manually operated device for extinguishing small fires
extinguisher.translation:
n. 熄灭者, 灭火器, 消灭者
[化] 灭火器; 灭火剂

extinguishers.definition: n. a manually operated device for extinguishing small fires
extinguishers.translation: n. 熄火者( extinguisher的复数形式 ); 消火者; 消火器; 熄火器

extinguishes.definition:
v put an end to; kill
v put out, as of fires, flames, or lights
v extinguish by crushing
v terminate, end, or take out
v kill in large numbers
extinguishes.translation: v. 使熄灭, 扑灭( extinguish的第三人称单数 ); 使…不复存在

extinguishing.definition:
n the act of extinguishing; causing to stop burning
v put an end to; kill
v put out, as of fires, flames, or lights
v extinguish by crushing
v terminate, end, or take out
v kill in large numbers

extinguishment.definition:
n. The act of extinguishing, putting out, or
   quenching, or the state of being extinguished; extinction; suppression;
   destruction; nullification; as, the extinguishment of fire or flame, of
   discord, enmity, or jealousy, or of love or affection.
n. The annihilation or extinction of a right or
   obligation.

extirpate.translation: vt. 连根拔起, 消灭, 根除, 毁灭

extirpated.translation: v. 消灭, 灭绝( extirpate的过去式和过去分词 ); 根除

extirpates.definition:
v destroy completely, as if down to the roots
v pull up by or as if by the roots
v surgically remove (an organ)
extirpates.translation: v. 消灭, 灭绝( extirpate的第三人称单数 ); 根除

extirpating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Extirpate
extirpating.translation: v. 消灭, 灭绝( extirpate的现在分词 ); 根除

extirpation.definition: n. the act of pulling up or out; uprooting; cutting off from existence
extirpation.translation:
n. 消灭, 根除, 毁灭
[医] 摘除

extirpative.definition: a. Capable of rooting out, or tending to root out.
extirpative.translation:
根除的
除尽的
灭绝的

extirpator.definition: n. One who extirpates or roots out; a destroyer.
extirpator.translation:
n. 根除者, 扑灭者
[医] 摘除器

extirpatory.translation: a. 根除的, 除尽的；灭绝的, 消灭的
